## Business
Music Japan LLC plans, produces and distributes artist releases, original music and BGM. It also operates genre-focused music brands and handles music licensing and collaboration inquiries.

## Core services
- Artist release planning and music production
- Original music and BGM production
- Global music distribution
- Music brand planning and operation
- Music licensing and collaboration

## Artists and music brands
- Yuma
- Cozy Cafe Jazz BGM
- Relaxing Classical Music Live
- Deep Sleep Music Radio
